label: Ross ideal weakening and permission boundaries
paraphrase: For arbitrary ideal frames: obligation weakens; PERMISSION_1 is dual to obligation of negation; guarded disjunction yields the other weak permission; both guards yield both; ideal exclusivity gives the exact equivalences. Closed serial mail-only and mail-or-burn controls refute unrestricted free choice, witness both weak permissions without PERMISSION_2, and show overlap defeats the reverse implication. Exact issued-content duty rejects weakening. An explicit weak-to-strong bridge transfers both permissions. No actual duty, authority, availability or root premise is established.
